fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Untick to pause this source without deleting it.

fields.label: Document Type
fields.description: The kind of document whose change fires this event, for example Sales Invoice.

fields.label: When
fields.description: The moment in the document's life that fires the event. Runs after the change is saved for good.
fields.options:
after_insert
on_update
on_submit
on_cancel
on_trash
after_delete

fields.label: Only When
fields.description: Optional rule using the document as doc, for example doc.grand_total > 1000. Leave empty to fire every time.

fields.label: Payload Mapping
fields.description: Maps each payload field to an expression on doc, for example {"customer": "doc.customer"}. Leave empty to send the document type and name only.

fields.label: Duplicate Guard
fields.description: Expression that identifies one real occurrence, for example doc.name. The event fires once per value within a short window. Leave empty to use the document type, name and event.
